library.title: Library
library.emptyHint: Add CBZ or CBR files stored on your device to start reading.
library.dropHint: Drop files to add them to your library
library.removeConfirm: Remove “{{title}}” from your library? Its saved copy and progress will be deleted.

emptyFilter.inProgress: You are not reading anything right now.
emptyFilter.read: You have not finished any comic yet.

library.editInfoHint: Volumes with the same series are grouped together. Change it to move this comic to another series.
library.removeManyConfirm_other: Delete {{count}} comics from your library? Their saved copies and progress will be deleted.
library.installHintBody: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”. It opens full screen, works offline and keeps your library safe from Safari clearing site data.

reader.title: Reader
reader.pageError: This page could not be loaded.

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacyText: MangaReader works fully offline. Your comics, progress and settings are stored only on this device and are never uploaded or shared.
settings.readingFooter: Used when opening a comic. You can change them while reading with the Aa button.
settings.brightnessFooter: Dims pages in the reader without changing the screen brightness.

errors.corrupt: The file is damaged or is not a valid comic archive.
errors.unsupported: This file format is not supported. Use CBZ or CBR files.
errors.empty: The file is empty or contains no images.
errors.quotaExceeded: There is not enough free space on the device.
errors.duplicate: This comic is already in your library.
errors.notFound: This comic is no longer available.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong while opening the file.
errors.invalidExport: This file is not a MangaReader library or it is damaged.

collections.title: Collections
collections.name: Name
collections.emptyText: Group your comics by series, mood or anything you like. Long-press a cover to add it.
collections.deleteConfirm: Delete the collection “{{name}}”? Its comics stay in your library.
collections.detailEmpty: Long-press a cover in the library and choose “Add to collection”.

optimize.title: Reduce Size

high.label: High
high.detail: Nearly identical, with plenty of detail for zooming.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.detail: Sharp at full screen on a phone. Recommended.

compact.label: Compact
compact.detail: Maximum savings. Noticeable when zooming in a lot.

optimize.explanation: Pages are downscaled and recompressed on your phone, offline. The file is only replaced once the new copy is complete; your progress, collections and cover are kept.
optimize.summaryNothing: Could not reduce them further: they were already small.
optimize.storageFooter: Reducing size recompresses pages to screen resolution. Balanced usually saves 50% to 80%. Keep the app open while it works.

mergeSeries.title: Merge Series
mergeSeries.noOthers: There are no other series in the library.
mergeSeries.hint: Each volume keeps its number and is ordered with the rest. To move a single volume, use Edit Info.

folder.title: Comics Folder
folder.footer: Copy your CBZ and CBR files into this folder from your computer (USB cable or Quick Share) and the app will offer to import them. The original is deleted once the app has its own copy; with "When Reduced", only if it is reduced on import. Android does not allow the whole Download folder: use a folder inside it, such as Download/Manga.
folder.newExports_one: There is an exported library ready to import.
folder.newExports_other: There are {{count}} exported libraries ready to import.
folder.unavailable: The comics folder cannot be opened. Choose it again in Settings › Comics Folder.

willDelete.never: The originals stay in the folder.
willDelete.afterReduce: The originals will be deleted from the folder once reduced (Settings › Reduce on Import).
willDelete.afterReduceOff: The originals stay in the folder: they are only deleted when reduced, and Reduce on Import is off.
willDelete.always: The originals will be deleted from the folder as soon as the app has its copy.

transfer.title: Move to Another Device
transfer.footer: Creates a single file with your comics, covers, progress and collections. Send it with Quick Share, Bluetooth or a cable and open it with MangaReader on the other device.
transfer.needsSpace: You need about {{size}} free while the file is created.
transfer.shareHint: Choose Quick Share to send it wirelessly to a nearby phone or PC.
